maya: Tiny docs PR #10820 updated private install quickstart but left an internal KMS link and an old SDK endpoint. Can someone fix both?
leo: I can swap the link to the public ops README. Which SDK snippet is old?
maya: The python example still points at `https://api.redwood.ai` in the env var. For private installs we should show the internal svc DNS pattern. Keep it short.
sam: Suggested SDK snippet: `export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://internal-redwood.<customer-vpc>.svc.cluster.local` then `python -c "import os, redwood; c = redwood.Client(endpoint=os.getenv('REDWOOD_ENDPOINT'))"`. Add a one-liner about CA in trust store.
leo: Replaced internal link with https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/kms/README.md#onprem-quickstart and added a minimal PKCS#11 sample: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L`. Noting vendor module paths vary.
maya: Perfect. Sam, can you also add a 2-line note recommending SNAT for sealed networks and persistence hint for sysctl? (1 line each)
sam: Added: `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.50.0.0/16 -j SNAT --to-source 198.51.100.22` and `echo net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 > /etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf`.
doc-bot: Link scan: internal URL redwood-internal/kms-runbook removed. All checks green.
maya: Thanks. Merging once CI preview builds. :shipit:
